intro: The Edward corner table brings timeless elegance and functionality to any living space. Crafted for style and durability, it’s the perfect addition to your space's compact and sophisticated setting.

features.title: Warm finish that feels like home
features.text: The rich walnut tone adds warmth and elegance, seamlessly blending with modern and traditional decor​.

features.title: Perfectly sized for your lifestyle
features.text: Ideal for corners, it maximises utility in smaller rooms without compromising on style or functionality​.

features.title: Strength you can rely on
features.text: Built with a rubberwood underframe and a high-density plywood top, it ensures long-lasting durability with a load-bearing capacity of 30 kg​.

features.title: Versatile and effortlessly stylish
features.text: Designed for various uses, it works beautifully as a decor display or a practical corner table for essentials​.

features.title: Low maintenance, high impact
features.text: Its smooth surface and quality materials make cleaning and upkeep effortless, keeping it looking pristine.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
